correctness.rationale: Ballot reflection counts give the exact full conditional joint law, bridge uniformity holds for all p because bridge path weights are equal, and the successive ballot-number ratio increases strictly in terminal height. Exact exhaustive rational verification matches the formula and all signs for n=1..7 and five rational p each; this is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The novelty assessed is strict all-horizon drift-sign covariance and likelihood-ratio meander sign monotonicity, not classical symmetric Chung–Feller uniformity. Neither inspected source states or implies the strict all-p finite covariance theorem without the additional MLR argument. Historical equivalent identities remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An older source on joint last-zero/sojourn statistics under Bernoulli drift may contain the same sign theorem in different terminology.

value.rationale: An exact finite-horizon sharp phase boundary for covariance of two central global random-walk functionals, with strict conditional-mean monotonicity and a structural TP2/MLR meander lemma. The p=1/2 zero law is a known symmetry, so determining the direction and strictness of drift perturbations for every n is a substantive dependence classification rather than reprinting a marginal formula.
